# Bobo Learns

> Bobo Learns is a personal sandbox for learning things, made by Babar Ali and open to everyone because it's fun. Each site is its own small experiment, free to use, and a single optional login works across them.

## Live apps

- [Bobo Learns Lingo](https://lingo.bobolearns.com): free language courses with structured lessons, flashcards, quizzes and an AI tutor: Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese and Urdu.
- [Bobo Learns Chess](https://chess.bobolearns.com): play and learn chess on a real board, with your laptop's camera as the eyes and the opponent.
